description: Functions and classes for working with Itasca thermal pebbles.

functions.name: count
functions.description: Get the number of thermal pebbles.

functions.name: find
functions.description: Get the thermal pebble object with the given ID number.

functions.name: inbox
functions.signature: itasca.clump.thermal.pebble.inbox(lower_bound: vec, upper_bound: vec, intersect=True) -> Tuple of thermal pebble objects
functions.description: Get a tuple of thermal pebbles with extents intersecting a box. The extent is the axis-aligned bounding box of the pebble. The if the optional keyword argument intersect is False then only thermal pebbles with positions falling in the box are returned.

functions.name: list
functions.description: Get a thermal pebble iterator object.

functions.name: maxid
functions.description: Get the maximum thermal pebble ID.

functions.name: near
functions.signature: itasca.clump.thermal.pebble.near(point: vec, radius=0.0) -> Thermal pebble object
functions.description: Find the closest thermal pebble to a point. If the optional keyword argument radius is non-zero, only search within this radius.
